name: Hearts
tagline: Dodge the hearts and the Queen of Spades — or shoot the moon.

rulesSummary: Three players: the 2♦ is out, 17 cards each. Passes go left, right, then none.
Five players: the 2♣ and 2♦ are out, 10 cards each, and the 3♣ leads. Some passes go two seats to the left or right.
Avoid taking hearts and the Q♠. Lowest score wins.
Before each hand, pass 3 cards. The direction changes every hand, and some hands have no pass.
Follow suit if you can; if not, play anything. There are no trumps: the highest card of the suit led wins.
The 2♣ leads the first trick. Nobody may play a heart or the Q♠ on it unless they have nothing else.
Hearts can't be led until a heart has been played (the Q♠ doesn't count), unless you hold only hearts.
Each heart you take is 1 point, the Q♠ is 13. Take all 26 to shoot the moon: take 26 off your score, or give everyone else 26. You choose.
When someone reaches the target (100 unless changed), the lowest score wins.
